title: Final product evaluation on the merged BRep line: 17 benchmark cases + 6 feature drawings x 2 backends
honesty_rules: Every trial is published, including failures. No cherry-picking.
Drawing-fidelity results are kept separate from solid-build success.
Unsupported operations are recorded as outcomes, not silent skips.
BRep-only capabilities are reported in their own table and are never counted as OpenSCAD failures, or vice versa.
This plan was committed before any trial ran; audit.py re-checks that frozen_at precedes every trial timestamp.
new_since_issue_34: issue #62 openings_through genus floor is active in the evaluator
issue #67 registers stroke-ring openings outside view outlines; demanded openings now sum per view
issue #68 size-ask runs with ask_missing_dimensions=false (harness default) so unattended trials never stall
003 grille drawing re-inked from trusted STL (24946c7); ink and reference now agree

infrastructure.server: in-process uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8132 (port range 8130-8139 reserved for this task)
infrastructure.model: local vLLM at http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 (never restarted by the harness)
infrastructure.matrix: 8 drawings x 2 backends x 5 trials = 80 generations

model_settings.policy: App defaults exactly as shipped: OPENAI_MODEL empty, model auto-discovered from GET /v1/models. Both backends use the same settings and run in the same app instance.

tolerances.extents: sorted extents within 2% per axis of the frozen reference (manifest tolerances.generated_dimension_relative = 0.02)
tolerances.note: Feature-position and opening counts are carried by the product's projection/opening checks; the harness adds independent genus, extents and volume checks. Tolerances are copied from benchmarks/brep-baseline/*/manifest.json and are fixed before the trial.

reference_measurements: references/reference-measurements.json (reference STLs cached under references/, measured deterministically with trimesh during plan preparation, before the trial)

pass_criteria.build_success: Harness re-measures the run STL independently: watertight AND exactly 1 component. Recorded separately from fidelity.
pass_criteria.extents_pass: sorted run extents vs sorted reference extents, every axis within 2%.
pass_criteria.genus_pass: genus == frozen reference genus (where a ground truth exists).
pass_criteria.volume_pass: abs(volume - reference volume)/reference volume <= 0.02 (where a ground truth exists).
pass_criteria.supplied_dimension_pass: abs(max(run extents) - case-supplied maximum dimension) <= tolerances.supplied_dimension_mm (1.0 mm). The case-supplied dimension is the frozen plan corpus 'dimension' actually sent with the request; reference-only ground-truth numbers are NOT part of this contract (they stay on extents_pass). Separate track: excluded from overall_pass, never retro-gates frozen rows.
pass_criteria.fidelity_pass: Harness re-runs doodle_to_cad.evaluation.projection_scores on (source drawing, run geometry evidence, run view renders). Every assigned direction must score >= 0.45. Kept separate from build_success. Product's own acceptance is recorded too but is not the harness pass.
pass_criteria.overall_pass: build_success AND extents_pass AND genus_pass AND volume_pass AND fidelity_pass. If a required ground truth does not exist for a check, that check is not_applicable and excluded (never counted as failed).
pass_criteria.product_acceptance: openscad: result.success (agent accepted, score >= 70). usd-brep: evaluation.status != 'failed' (the BRep path never auto-accepts fidelity; evaluation.accepted stays false by design).
pass_criteria.recovery: openscad: attempts = len(result.attempts); recovered = success AND attempts > 1 (a failing first attempt recovered within the bounded 3-attempt loop). usd-brep: attempts = len(generation.attempts) + construction corrections len(generation.construction_attempts); recovered = built AND any of those > 1.
pass_criteria.edit_time: Parameter preview round-trip: GET /api/results/{run}/params, pick the first numeric parameter (prefer names matching thick|width|radius|depth|height), set value*1.2 clamped to [min,max], POST /api/results/{run}/parametrize; wall time to response. ok = response ok AND applied non-empty.
pass_criteria.targeted_edit: usd-brep only (the product rejects targeted edits on OpenSCAD results; recorded as not_applicable, not failed). Requires a non-empty diagnostics.selection_catalog.targets: choose the first target via POST selection, derive the operation name locally with targeted_edits.plan, then POST revisions/targeted with value*1.2. Time and outcome recorded.
pass_criteria.unsupported_operation: usd-brep jobs ending with error code unsupported_construction, unresolved_design, or a clarification stall are recorded as unsupported_operation outcomes. They stay in the tables.

clarification_policy.on_stall: cancel the job and record status=clarification_stalled

evidence_layout.runs: runs/<drawing>/<backend>/trial-<NN>/{result.json, job.json, row.json, input.png, views/*, model.scad|model.recipe.json, failed/ (failed attempt scads/logs)}
evidence_layout.index: runs/index.jsonl (one raw row per trial; README counts are recomputed from it by audit.py)
evidence_layout.stl_policy: every run STL is sha256-pinned in the row; STL bytes are archived in the evidence folder only for failed-build runs and any run whose STL is under 1.5 MB
evidence_layout.environment: environment.json (git rev, python versions, usd-brep version, model, dates) written at trial end; SHA256SUMS sealed last

plan_revisions.change: dimension corrected 100 -> 120/54/60 to match the certified #34 TRIAL-PLAN dimensions for these baseline drawings; the initial frozen plan had hand-picked 100 mm, which made the ground-truth extents checks measure against a size the drawing was never intended to build at.
plan_revisions.affected_rows: 30 previously-published rows kept; 12 cells deleted and rerun at corrected dimensions

plan_revisions.change: added supplied_dimension_pass (tolerances.supplied_dimension_mm = 1.0): a dimension actually supplied with the request must be honoured in the mesh within 1 mm. Declared per #102 because the plan previously had no check that the model honoured a number the user gave it; the 2% extents check measures reference-only values (dimensions never supplied), conflating propagation failures with ink-inference failures.
plan_revisions.affected_rows: none: separate track excluded from overall_pass; already-frozen rows keep their meaning; future runs gain the check
